title: Folder Sync configuration
description: Configuration for a folder treated as a sync source. The folder containing this file is the source root; each entry in `destinations` identifies a workspace folder to sync into by its URI.

destinations.description: One or more destinations to sync this folder into. Each `uri` must match the URI of a workspace folder open in vscode.dev (see .admin-sync.jsonc for the canonical list).

uri.description: URI of a workspace folder, exactly as it appears in .admin-sync.jsonc (e.g. file:///handle/... in the web extension host). Stable across folder renames. Unresolved URIs are skipped at sync time with a warning.

path.description: Optional subpath within the destination workspace folder. Sync writes into `<workspaceFolder>/<path>`. Leave empty to write at the destination root.

exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude, in addition to the built-in ignore list (.git, .DS_Store, ~$*, .sync.jsonc, .roomSync, .foldersync-manifest.json).

items.description: Glob pattern. Supports *, ?, **, and trailing /** to match a directory and its contents.

include.description: Glob patterns to include. Omit (or leave empty) to include everything not excluded.

items.description: Glob pattern. Supports *, ?, **, and trailing /** to match a directory and its contents.

path-aliases.description: Source-rewrite layer. Each entry maps a source-relative directory (LHS) to a destination-relative directory (RHS). When non-empty, only files inside one of the listed LHS directories sync — files outside every LHS are dropped (no implicit catch-all). Aliases combine additively; precedence is the order of the entries (first match wins). Wildcards are supported: `*` matches one path segment and captures its value; `**` matches multiple segments. The n-th wildcard on the LHS feeds the n-th wildcard on the RHS, so `{ "*/room1": "*" }` unifies MON/room1, TUE/room1, WED/room1 under a single destination keyed by the captured day. Useful for unifying day-major source layouts into a single room-major destination tree.

additionalProperties.description: Destination-relative directory. Leave empty to strip the LHS prefix and write files at the destination root. `*` / `**` wildcards on this side are substitution markers — they're replaced with the n-th captured value from the LHS.
